title: Reuters reports Meta employees flagged privacy problems with its Muse AI agent; Meta calls them isolated incidents
date_note: The pages give the Reuters report only as relayed on 19 November; no earlier day is stated.
geo_basis: company named in the reports; no location stated
summary: According to Reuters, as relayed by 9to5Mac and Detik, Meta employees reported that its Muse AI agent sent messages unrelated to their conversations, including what appeared to be bank balances, and seemed to have accessed a Signal message. Meta told Reuters these were "isolated incidents" and said the balances may have been AI hallucinations; Meta later told 9to5Mac they were "definitely hallucinations".
plain: Reuters reported that staff said Meta's Muse AI agent sent odd messages, including apparent bank balances. Meta says these were isolated incidents and that the balances were hallucinations.
exec: Meta says the cases are isolated; Reuters' reporting raises privacy questions about AI agents with access to other apps.
impact: Reported by Meta employees; Meta disputes that the bank balances were real user data.

validation.note: 9to5Mac and Detik both relay one Reuters investigation; the Reuters article itself could not be opened, so this is single-source.
